therapeutic_hypothesis.compound: LGX818 (Encorafenib) + MEK162 (Binimetinib) + third agents (BKM120, LEE011, BGJ398, INC280)
therapeutic_hypothesis.proposed_mechanism: BRAF kinase inhibition + MEK kinase inhibition + additional pathway inhibition to overcome resistance
therapeutic_hypothesis.intended_biology: Dual MAPK pathway blockade with additional pathway inhibition to prevent resistance mechanisms in BRAF-mutant melanoma
therapeutic_hypothesis.primary_endpoint: Overall Response Rate (ORR) in Part II

results.effect_size: ORR: Encorafenib + Binimetinib + Ribociclib 2.6% (95% CI: 0.1-13.8), Capmatinib 0% (95% CI: 0.0-24.7), Buparlisib 0% (95% CI: 0.0-45.9)
results.target_engagement_evidence: Extensive PK data showing drug exposure for all agents with dose-dependent plasma concentrations
biomarker_changes: BRAF V600E mutations detected at baseline and EOT
Various genomic alterations in CCND1, CDK4, EGFR, FGFR1, MET, PTEN observed
subgroup_findings: Part I naive patients had better outcomes than non-naive
Very limited efficacy in Part II triple combinations
safety_signals: High rates of AEs in all arms (>90%)
Cardiac events including myocardial infarction and cardiac arrest
Frequent dose interruptions and reductions required
results.dose_information: Multiple dose levels tested: Encorafenib 100-450mg, Binimetinib 30-45mg, with third agents at various doses

context.duration: Maximum treatment exposure Part I: 403.7 weeks, Part II: 97.0 weeks
